WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT ty.store_weeks, ty.stores, ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
    GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) AS fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) AS store_id, m.mine, c.ctl, ROUND(m.mine - c.ctl,2) AS gap
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_year = m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id = m.store_id
WHERE m.mine IS NULL OR c.ctl IS NULL OR ABS(m.mine - c.ctl) > 1
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_line_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id || '-' || f.line_no) AS distinct_receipt_lines, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH s AS (
  SELECT st.store_id, st.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) AS net, SUM(r.receipts) AS receipts
  FROM dim_store st
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=1 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')) d
  LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.store_id = st.store_id AND r.business_date BETWEEN d.fiscal_week_start_date AND d.fiscal_week_start_date + 6
  WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
)
SELECT t.store_id, t.store_name, t.fiscal_week, ROUND(t.net) AS ty, ROUND(l.net) AS ly, ROUND(100.0*(t.net/NULLIF(l.net,0)-1),1) AS pct
FROM s t JOIN s l ON l.store_id=t.store_id AND l.fiscal_week=t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE t.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND (t.net IS NULL OR l.net IS NULL OR t.net=0 OR l.net=0 OR ABS(t.net/l.net-1) > 0.25 OR t.store_id IN (104,119,125,129,136,137))
ORDER BY 1,3

WITH ty AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS net, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.is_trading_day THEN d.calendar_date END) AS trading_days
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=1 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id < 900 AND r.store_id <> 129
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT t.fiscal_week, ROUND(t.net) AS ty, ROUND(l.net) AS ly, ROUND(100.0*(t.net/l.net-1),2) AS growth_pct, t.trading_days AS ty_days, l.trading_days AS ly_days,
       ROUND(100.0*((t.net/t.trading_days)/(l.net/l.trading_days)-1),2) AS per_trading_day_pct
FROM ty t JOIN ty l ON l.fiscal_week=t.fiscal_week AND l.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE t.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week),
range_start AS (SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week),
weeks AS (SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year) AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year)
SELECT params.ty_year AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
